Build and improve automated deployment pipelines that make infrastructure changes faster, safer and more repeatable. Monitor, optimise and troubleshoot infrastructure performance, availability, security and cost. Implement effective observability using technologies such as CloudWatch, Grafana and Datadog. Strengthen identity and access management, encryption, network security and wider cloud controls. Design disaster recovery and business continuity solutions, including backup, failover and multi-region architecture. Evaluate emerging cloud technologies and determine where they can provide meaningful technical or commercial value. The resources and support required to build infrastructure properly. The compensation and benefits associated with a top global investment firm.
